reported_state: The source A and B units remain distinct. For A, the Lean adapter formalizes complete Q/K orbit coordinates on the finite raw-solder carrier, assuming IsUnit det(rawSolderMatrix N e x) at every reference site; IsRoleLorentz denotes the full O(1,3) isometry group, so fixed proper/time-oriented components are not encoded. For B, the source-convention adapter maps its frame by right multiplication with eta into the existing solder Gram carrier, retains the quadratic remainder, and proves the full matrix-variable Frechet derivative at the flat frame. The derivative composes with the finite solder readout over arbitrary LocalCoframeField N perturbations and is collected into one Frechet derivative for the whole output field x ↦ solderMetricMatrix N e x, whose value at each site is exactly the existing coframeMetricReadout. Matrix derivatives use the Frobenius norm and full fields use inherited finite Pi norms. The selected-action-to-Lean-carrier map, source A component restriction to SO+(1,3), global connection elimination, physical metric/source selection and independent C0 acceptance remain open; acceptance_inferred=false.
